description: UNIV8 — Sovereign Multi-Agent Exploration Universe (OpenCode Stack & Socle PRA)

vault.role: Encrypt and serve secrets via AES-256-GCM REST interface (port 8610)

specialize.how: Bootstrap from resources file, run in univ8-vault Podman container

logger.role: JSONL audit trail for beats, mailbox checks and ops events (port 8620)

specialize.how: Run in univ8-logger container with volume mounted to ./log

bridge-opencode.role: HTTP bridge to OpenCode CLI embedded inside container (port 4440)

specialize.how: Run in univ8-bridge-opencode container with Bearer token authentication

queue.role: Asynchronous job queue & auto-dispatcher to OpenCode bridge (port 8640)

specialize.how: Run in univ8-queue container auto-dispatching to univ8-bridge-opencode

maestro.role: Cadence scheduler — orchestrates agent beats to OpenCode bridge (port 8630)

agent.role: Unified AI bridge host and beat handler

specialize.how: Register task definitions dynamically from maestro-tasks.podman.json

helm.role: Web Chat UI (React 19 / Express 5) + Deepgram STT/TTS (port 8650)

specialize.how: Run in univ8-helm container connecting to univ8-bridge-opencode

tunnel.role: Cloudflare Zero Trust edge tunnel exposing ${SHAPER_PUBLIC_HOST} → port 8650

specialize.how: Run in univ8-tunnel container with token from ./sav/tunnel/token
